dates.name: Art Exhibit Opening Reception — 'And the Journey Continues'
dates.desc: Opening reception for paintings by Dr. Sam Forlenza runs through May 1. Spring art opening with refreshments and a chance to meet the artist. Intimate gallery setting downtown. Great way to start a date exploring local art.
dates.where: Salt Lake City (exact gallery location TBD — check local art listings)

dates.name: Soul Blind Live at Kilby Court
dates.desc: Local music at the beloved indie venue Kilby Court downtown. Energetic live performance in an intimate setting with great acoustics. Perfect for music lovers seeking an authentic local experience.
dates.where: Kilby Court — 741 S Main St, Salt Lake City, UT 84101

dates.name: American Moon Live at Kilby Court
dates.desc: Another great night at Kilby Court featuring American Moon. Intimate indie venue perfect for catching up-and-coming talent. Low-key date night for music lovers.
dates.where: Kilby Court — 741 S Main St, Salt Lake City, UT 84101

dates.name: ⚽ HISTORIC: Real Salt Lake vs Inter Miami (Lionel Messi!) — MLS Showdown
dates.desc: MESSI'S FIRST-EVER APPEARANCE IN UTAH! This is a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to see one of the greatest soccer players of all time live. Inter Miami arrives for the first time at America First Field. The energy will be electric with 30,000+ fans. Book through resale platforms if needed. This is a bucket-list sporting event for true fans.
dates.where: America First Field — 301 E South Temple, Salt Lake City, UT 84102
dates.reservation: tickets (buy via Ticketmaster, StubHub, Vivid Seats)

dates.name: Celebration Dinner at Riverhorse on Main — Park City Fine Dining
dates.desc: One of Park City's most celebrated restaurants in a historic building with exposed stone and soaring ceilings. Exceptional proteins including signature mountain trout and outstanding elk tenderloin. Deep wine list with sommelier recommendations. Reservations essential, ideally booked 4-6 weeks ahead for Friday nights. Perfect Friday date night.
dates.where: Riverhorse on Main — 540 Main St, Park City, UT 84060

dates.name: Spring Celebration Festival — Utah State Fairpark
dates.price: Free entry (food & vendor items à la carte)
dates.desc: Full day spring celebration featuring live music, dancing, artisan vendors, and food trucks. Family-friendly with a mix of cultural traditions and modern festival vibes. Great for exploring local makers and grabbing dinner from food trucks.
dates.where: Utah State Fairpark — 155 N 1000 W, Salt Lake City, UT 84116

dates.name: Phantom of the Opera — Broadway at the Eccles Theater
dates.desc: The iconic Broadway classic with the stunning music you know by heart. Professional touring production with incredible staging and costumes. Final performances at the Eccles. Evening matinee perfect after daytime festival activities. Reserve in advance.
dates.where: Eccles Theater — 131 S Main St, Salt Lake City, UT 84101

dates.name: Thanksgiving Point Tulip Festival — Ashton Gardens (Peak Sunday Visit)
dates.desc: Peak tulip season! Over 1 million flowers across 50 acres including 400,000 tulips in 175+ varieties. Sunday features live music, local vendors, and food trucks. Perfect for photos, strolling, and enjoying spring blooms together. The festival has excellent walkability and stunning photo spots throughout. Last chance to see the festival at its best.
dates.where: Thanksgiving Point — Ashton Gardens, 3900 N. Garden Drive, Lehi, UT 84048

dates.name: Korean BBQ at Seoul Meat Co. — Lehi
dates.desc: Full-service All-You-Can-Eat Korean BBQ with circular grills at your table. Cook your own premium meats and sides while enjoying the interactive dining experience. Great atmosphere and friendly service. Perfect for couples wanting to have fun and try new flavors together.
dates.where: Seoul Meat Co. — Lehi, UT (North of Thanksgiving Point)

dates.name: Fine Dining at The Tree Room — Sundance Resort
dates.desc: Forbes Four-Star, Michelin-rated fine dining with stunning mountain views. Seasonal menu featuring locally-sourced ingredients and creative presentations. Closed Sundays and Mondays. Reservations required well in advance. Dress code: smart casual. An unforgettable culinary experience.
dates.where: The Tree Room — Sundance Resort, 8841 Alpine Loop Rd, Sundance, UT 84604

dates.name: Utah Symphony: David Robertson Conducts The Film Music of Bernard Herrmann
dates.desc: A beautiful evening of iconic film composer Bernard Herrmann's greatest works. Conductor David Robertson leads the Utah Symphony through scores from Psycho, Vertigo, Taxi Driver, and more. Stunning orchestral arrangements. Perfect for music lovers and film enthusiasts. Wednesday evening concert.
dates.where: Abravanel Hall — 123 W South Temple, Salt Lake City, UT 84101

dates.name: Dinner at Handle — Park City's Most Talked-About Restaurant
dates.desc: The most talked-about restaurant among Park City locals. Small plates built around seasonal and local ingredients with an inventive cocktail program. Sophisticated yet approachable atmosphere on Main Street. Reservations highly recommended. Great for trying something creative and delicious.
dates.where: Handle — 415 Main St, Park City, UT 84060

dates.name: Dinner at Tupelo Park City — Globally-Inspired Farm-to-Table
dates.desc: Chef Matt Harris's celebrated restaurant showcasing artisanal ingredients: fresh Idaho trout, natural Utah lamb, heirloom grains, and housemade pasta. Sophisticated atmosphere with carefully curated wine pairings. Reservations essential. Friday night special — a perfect way to celebrate the end of the week.
dates.where: Tupelo Park City — 1375 Park Ave, Park City, UT 84060

dates.name: Bell's Canyon Waterfall Hike — Easy to Moderate Spring Adventure
dates.desc: Classic Wasatch hike starting just 25 minutes from downtown Sandy. Relatively easy trail until the final mile becomes rocky with possible snow patches in late April/early May. Stunning canyon scenery with waterfall views at the end. Perfect spring outing with minimal elevation gain.
dates.where: Bell's Canyon Trailhead — Sandy, UT (25 min from SLC downtown)

dates.name: Natural History Museum of Utah — Dinosaurs & Interactive Exhibits
dates.price: $24.95/adult (Wednesday until 9 PM if you go in evening)
dates.desc: World-class natural history museum with extensive dinosaur skeletons, interactive science exhibits, and hands-on learning. The Red Butte Garden is attached if you want to extend the outing. Excellent full-day or half-day activity with amazing views of the valley from the building.
dates.where: Natural History Museum of Utah — 301 S 1300 E, Salt Lake City, UT 84112

dates.name: Trappers Lake Trail — Little Cottonwood Canyon
dates.desc: Moderate 3.5-mile hike to a pristine alpine lake surrounded by wildflowers and mountain peaks. April-May is ideal for spring runoff views and blooming wildflowers. Less crowded than the famous Donut Falls, with equally stunning scenery. Great for photography.
dates.where: Trappers Lake Trailhead — Little Cottonwood Canyon Rd, UT (~25 miles from SLC)

dates.name: Antelope Island State Park — Spring Wildlife & Wildflowers
dates.desc: April-May is peak season for island wildflowers blooming across sagebrush terrain. Roam the island by car or hike to see native bison herds, pronghorn, and bighorn sheep. Sunset views of the Great Salt Lake are spectacular. Pack a picnic or bring dinner supplies.
dates.where: Antelope Island State Park — 4528 W 1700 S, Syracuse, UT 84075

dates.name: Snowbird Aerial Tram — High Alpine Scenic Experience
dates.desc: Ride the aerial tram 2,000 vertical feet to Hidden Peak (11,000 ft) for 360-degree views of the Wasatch Mountains, Lake Utah, and beyond. Accessible April-October. Walk the trails, visit the summit restaurant, or simply breathe the crisp alpine air. No skiing required — just stunning views.
dates.where: Snowbird Resort — 9385 E Snowbird Tram Rd, Snowbird, UT 84092

dates.name: Bridal Veil Falls — Provo Canyon Easy Waterfall Hike
dates.price: Free (parking at trailhead; note: lower lot closed until July 2026, use upper lot)
dates.desc: Easy 1.3-mile paved path (first part) leading to a stunning 607-foot double waterfall. Perfect spring outing with minimal elevation gain. Shaded trail, great for families and couples. Can be crowded on weekends, so arrive early for the best photos.
dates.where: Bridal Veil Falls Trailhead — Provo Canyon (US-189), Provo, UT (from I-15 take 800 North exit)

dates.name: Goblin Valley State Park — Otherworldly Scenic Drive & Hike
dates.desc: One of Utah's most unique landscapes featuring strange sandstone formations that look like Mars. April-May offers perfect weather (65-85°F). Two-mile scenic drive with pullouts, plus trails through the goblins. Less crowded than major parks. Arrive morning or late afternoon to avoid crowds.
dates.where: Goblin Valley State Park — 18630 Goblin Valley Rd, Green River, UT (off Hwy 24)

dates.name: Dinner at Riverhorse on Main — Park City Landmark Fine Dining
dates.desc: One of Park City's most celebrated restaurants in a historic building with exposed stone and soaring ceilings. Signature mountain trout and outstanding elk tenderloin with a deep wine list. Intimate, sophisticated atmosphere. Essential reservations; book 4-6 weeks ahead.
dates.where: Riverhorse on Main — 540 Main St, Park City, UT 84060

dates.name: Park City Historic Main Street — Explore & Dine
dates.desc: Walkable historic district lined with local restaurants, galleries, and shops. Grab coffee at a local café, browse art galleries, and choose from diverse dining options (pizza, sushi, burgers, fine dining). Live music often plays on weekends. Perfect for a relaxed spring afternoon.
dates.where: Park City Historic Main Street — Park City, UT (various restaurants/galleries)

dates.name: Sunday Brunch at The Foundry Grill — Sundance Resort
dates.desc: Celebrated farm-to-table buffet brunch with farm-fresh ingredients, seasonal dishes, and mountain views. Open 9 AM - 2 PM on Sundays. Outstanding quality and selection. Reservations recommended. Perfect for a leisurely spring Sunday morning.
dates.where: The Foundry Grill — Sundance Resort, 8841 Alpine Loop Rd, Sundance, UT 84604

dates.name: Japanese Dinner at Tsunami Restaurant — Lehi
dates.desc: Highly-rated Japanese restaurant with fresh sushi, creative rolls, and authentic entrees. Excellent service and a warm atmosphere. Great for couples who enjoy trying different cuisines. Located near Thanksgiving Point for easy pairing with other Lehi activities.
dates.where: Tsunami Restaurant — Lehi, UT (near Thanksgiving Point)

dates.name: TopGolf at Vineyard — Gamified Golf Experience
dates.desc: Gamified golf bays with automatic scoring, full food menu, and zero golf skill required. Fun, competitive energy with lively bar scene. Bay pricing is per bay, not per person — great value for two. Play games, grab food, enjoy the vibe.
dates.where: TopGolf — 484 N Entertainment Way, Vineyard, UT 84059

dates.name: Indoor Rock Climbing at Momentum Gym — Fun Challenge Date
dates.desc: Multiple Utah locations including Trolley Square, Millcreek, and Lehi. Perfect for couples wanting to try something new and physical together. Beginner-friendly with classes available. Great energy, helpful staff, and fun competition. No experience needed.
dates.where: Momentum Climbing — Trolley Square (602 E 500 S, SLC) or Millcreek (3173 E 3300 S, SLC)

dates.name: Jordanelle State Park — Scenic Reservoir Hike & Picnic
dates.desc: Perched above the beautiful Heber Valley with stunning alpine lake views. Multiple scenic trails ranging from easy to moderate. Day-use areas with picnic facilities overlooking the water. Perfect for a relaxing spring hike and lunch with a view.
dates.where: Jordanelle State Park — Heber, UT (45 min from SLC)

dates.name: Clark Planetarium + The Gateway District Stroll
dates.desc: Free interactive science museum with immersive space exhibits and full-dome IMAX theater. Then stroll The Gateway district for dessert, shopping, art installations, or an arcade bar. Easy afternoon with lots of options.
dates.where: Clark Planetarium — 110 S 400 W, Salt Lake City, UT 84101

dates.name: Park City Gondola Art Stroll — Mountain Views + Local Art
dates.desc: Ride the scenic gondola at Canyons Village with panoramic mountain views, then explore local art galleries and installations throughout Park City. Combine outdoor scenic rides with cultural exploration.
dates.where: Canyons Village — Park City, UT

dates.name: Escape Room at Getout Games — Salt Lake City
dates.desc: Four themed rooms downtown: Egyptian Tomb, Zombie on a Chain, The Heist, or Reactor Room. 60 minutes of puzzle-solving and teamwork under pressure. Book in advance; evening slots available daily. Great problem-solving chemistry builder.
dates.where: Getout Games — 202 W 400 S, Salt Lake City, UT 84101

dates.name: Date Night Cooking Class — Salt Lake Culinary Education
dates.desc: Interactive 3-hour cooking class where you and your partner learn new culinary skills, explore global cuisines, and cook a meal together. Includes dining with wine pairings. Upcoming dates include April 18, and more available. Fun, interactive, and delicious!
dates.where: Salt Lake Culinary Education (SLICE) — 2233 S 300th E, Salt Lake City, UT 84115
